description: Ranking history of a watched keyword: per capture the top 10 app ids, or with app, that app's rank over time (best, worst, latest). Default the last 90 days. The id is a keyword slot of a keyword watch (list_watches and watch show the slot ids) or a list_tracked_keywords id. Cost: 1 credits.

app.description: Store app id; returns `rank` per point instead of the full id list.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

from.description: Start, ISO date or datetime (default 90 days ago)

id.description: Keyword slot id (from a keyword watch, or list_tracked_keywords)

to.description: End date or datetime (ISO), default now.

name: get_keyword_ranks
title: Get Keyword Ranks
